review_basis: Independent six-view depth-buffered PBR render of the exported GLB
observations: The generated object is not a coherent elephant.
Large sections are stretched, torn, duplicated and collapsed across depth.
The legs, trunk, body and decorative shell do not form reliable connected anatomy.
Texture detail is projected onto incorrect geometry and cannot compensate for the shape failure.
The model must not be scaled or delivered as a 17-inch or 21-inch OBJ.
accepted_uses: Research comparison against other open-source image-to-3D baselines
next_action: Do not scale this mesh for delivery. Continue with geometry-aware multi-view reconstruction and separate relief/detail recovery.
preview_method: Independent six-view depth-buffered PBR render of the exported GLB
